introMd: Skateboard Race Simulator lets you train your speed and race automatically to climb leaderboards. Using Skateboard Race Simulator codes can give you boosts like extra speed or double wins, helping you unlock new boards and pets faster. These codes are a neat way to grab free perks without grinding too long, so knowing how and when to use them can really improve your gameplay.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Skateboard Race Simulator Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes, just make sure you enter them exactly as shown since they are case sensitive. Follow these steps to claim your rewards:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Skateboard Race Simulator]].
2. Click the Codes button on the right side of the screen.
3. Type or paste the code into the Enter Code box.
4. Press the Submit button to receive your rewards.
Make sure to enter codes carefully to avoid errors.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Skateboard Race Simulator mostly grant boosts that directly affect your racing and training performance. Here are the typical rewards:

| Reward Type          | Description                                               |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| Double Wins Boost   | Doubles the number of wins you earn during races, speeding up leaderboard progress.
| Speed Boost         | Adds extra speed points to your character, making training and racing faster.
| Power Potion        | Gives temporary power boosts that enhance your skating abilities.

These rewards help you move faster through the game’s zones and unlock better skateboards and pets.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if you mistype them since they are case sensitive and include numbers. Also, codes can only be used once per account. If you see an invalid code message, it usually means the code has expired and is no longer active.
